text:
sophie: Hey team — acme POC hitting 429s on embeddings during bulk upload. Started ~10:15am PT, cc @nina @matt. customer says ~10% failure on upload step

nina: can you paste a sample request id + log lines? which model/route are they hitting?

sophie: here's the snippet from their logs (sanitized):
```
root_req=abcd1234 route=/v1/embeddings model=open-embed-xx status=429 reason=per-route-rate-limit concurrency=24 tokens=0
timestamp=2026-03-21T17:15:32Z
```

matt: looks like a per-route concurrency cap. Default trial cap for embed route is 20 concurrent requests; they’re hitting 24 from their parallel uploader. Two quick mitigation options: throttle client concurrency to <=20 or request a short demo bump.

jordan: do we know what sales provisioned for their trial? if they planned 30 parallel workers that explains it. I can do a temporary bump but need acct id + time window.

sophie: acct id acct_9876. They expected to do 30 concurrent uploads for a 5k-record import. Sales wants guidance on cost + whether we can flip a switch for the demo.

nina: client-side fixes first: reduce concurrency (8-12), add exponential backoff with jitter, and chunk records into smaller batches (e.g., 500-record chunks). That massively reduces spike risk and total token consumption.

matt: also note trial envs have stricter limits. For demos we can enable a per-route burst increase (temporary) — ops approval required. Jordan any objections?

jordan: fine from SRE. I can approve a 2-hour bump to concurrency=50 for the route if ops tickets and justification are in place. Please create an internal ops ticket and include start/end times.

sophie: opened ops ticket INC-2026 with details and requested 3pm–5pm PT bump. I pasted logs, acct_9876, and customer contact. Also customer asked whether extra usage will be billed. @matt any guidance?

matt: for POCs we usually absorb short demo infra; but overages beyond trial quota typically bill. We can approve a waiver for demo overages if the deal is qualified (ACV threshold). cc finance.

lina: from finance: we can waive up to $500 demo overage if AE signs off; otherwise it'll bill at list rate. Sophie please send expected token estimate and AE approval.

sophie: estimate: naive calc 5k records * ~1k tokens = ~5M tokens. Nina you mentioned optimizations reduce that — what’s realistic?

nina: with batching and trim prompts I expect ~1.2M tokens for that import. Also advise using the smaller embedding model for experiments to cut compute.

matt: engineering ready to apply bump once ops ticket is approved. I also deployed a staging-verification where we simulated 50 concurrent workers and saw no errors.

sophie: I'll run the verification upload at 2:30pm PT against staging and report back. Jordan — once ops approves, please flip bump 3pm. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
